site.title: Octos — The Backend OS for AI Agents
site.description: One brain, many arms. Your AI on every channel — Telegram, Discord, Slack, WeChat, and more. One 31MB binary, 15 LLM providers, zero dependencies.

footer.brandDescription: Open Cognitive Tasks Orchestration System — a Rust-native, API-first Agentic OS for AI agents.

hero.heading: One brain, many arms
hero.description: Like an octopus — 9 brains, every arm thinks on its own, yet they move as one. Your AI shouldn't live in one chat window. Give it Telegram, Discord, Slack, WeChat — every channel your people use. One binary, zero dependencies.

items.title: Your agents, your way
items.description: 92 API endpoints to build any interface on top — web dashboards, mobile apps, CLI tools, or embed AI into your existing product.

items.title: Room for everyone
items.description: One 31MB binary serves 200+ users on a single machine. Each person gets their own agent with private memory, sessions, and data.

items.title: Best model for each task
items.description: Cheap models for planning, powerful ones for synthesis. Chain multiple LLMs in a single workflow with automatic failover when one goes down.

items.title: Always online
items.description: Three layers of failover keep your agents running even when a provider goes down. Hedge racing, circuit breakers, automatic switching.

items.title: Smart tool management
items.description: 30+ tools available, but only 15 loaded at once. Octos activates what your agent needs and quietly puts away the rest — fast responses, no bloat.

items.title: Conversations that flow
items.description: Five queue modes control how your agent handles busy moments — queue messages, collect them, steer mid-conversation, or let users interrupt.

items.title: It remembers
items.description: Your agent knows what you talked about yesterday, your preferences, your projects. Three memory layers keep the right context in reach.

items.title: Documents, slides, spreadsheets
items.description: Generate PPTX, DOCX, and XLSX natively — no LibreOffice, no external tools, no network calls. Pure Rust, zero dependencies.

items.title: Built safe
items.description: Agents run in isolated sandboxes. No unsafe code anywhere in the project. 67 prompt injection tests and counting.

architecture.label: Architecture
architecture.heading:
Simple inside,
powerful outside
architecture.description: Eight focused modules, one 31MB binary. No runtime, no Docker, no pip install. Download and run.

deepResearch.label: Deep Research
deepResearch.heading:
Think deeper,
search wider
deepResearch.description: One agent designs the research plan, others fan out to search in parallel. Cheap models plan, powerful ones synthesize. Every step is a different model.

features.label: Self-healing routes

toolSystem.label: Tools
toolSystem.heading: A well-organized toolbox
toolSystem.description: 30+ tools available, but your agent only loads what it needs right now. Idle tools quietly step aside — keeping responses fast and context windows lean.

tiers.label: On standby
tiers.description: Activated when needed, put away when done

tiers.label: Catalog
tiers.description: No limit on what your agent can learn to do

memory.label: Memory
memory.heading: It remembers
memory.description: Your agent knows what you talked about yesterday. It remembers your preferences, your projects, your decisions — and forgets nothing you want kept. Three layers, one seamless experience.

layers.title: What it always knows about you
layers.description: Preferences, projects, recurring topics — auto-extracted and ready for instant recall.

layers.title: What it learned from each task
layers.description: Files modified, decisions made, outcomes achieved — searchable by keyword or meaning.

layers.title: The current conversation
layers.description: Always in context, auto-compacted when it gets long. Switch threads with /new, /s, /back.

contentGen.label: Content
contentGen.heading: Documents, slides, spreadsheets
contentGen.description: Ask your agent to make a slide deck, write a report, or build a spreadsheet. It generates real Office files — no LibreOffice, no network calls, zero dependencies.

formats.name: PPTX
formats.description: Slide decks with layouts, images, and charts

formats.name: DOCX
formats.description: Documents with headings, tables, and images

formats.name: XLSX
formats.description: Spreadsheets with formulas, styling, and charts

art.label: AI Art Pipeline
art.heading: 17 visual styles
art.description: Cards, comics, infographics, posters, diagrams, timelines, and more. Each style is a composable template with AI-driven content placement.

security.label: Security
security.heading: Built to be trusted
security.description: Your data stays on your machine. Every agent runs in a sandbox. No unsafe code in the entire project. Security isn't an afterthought — it's the foundation.

layers.title: Agents can't break out
layers.description: Each agent runs in its own isolated sandbox that blocks dangerous operations — on Linux, macOS, and Docker.

layers.title: No unsafe code
layers.description: The entire codebase enforces deny(unsafe_code). Pure Rust with rustls for TLS — no OpenSSL, no C dependencies.

layers.title: Prompt injection defense
layers.description: 67 injection tests covering input sanitization and output filtering. Constant-time comparison prevents timing attacks.

layers.title: Your data stays yours
layers.description: Each agent operates in a scoped workspace. File access is restricted to its own directory. No cross-tenant data leakage.

layers.title: Safe credentials
layers.description: macOS Keychain integration for API key storage. No plaintext secrets in config files.

layers.title: Process isolation
layers.description: Each user gets a separate OS process with its own memory space, sessions, and data — true multi-tenancy.

performance.label: Performance
performance.heading: Runs on a Mac Mini
performance.description: 200+ AI agents serving thousands of users — on hardware you already own. No Kubernetes, no auto-scaling, no 3am pages. 20MB per agent, cold start under 100ms.

channels.label: Gateway
channels.heading: Meet your users where they are
channels.description: Your AI lives on Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, WeChat, and 7 more platforms. One agent, every channel — with full conversation history wherever your users talk.

providers.label: LLM Layer
providers.heading: 15 AI providers
providers.description: Pick the right model for each task. Chain providers in a single pipeline — if one goes down, the next one takes over automatically.

comparison.label: Comparison
comparison.heading: Different animals, different oceans
comparison.description: Not better or worse — just different. Octos is infrastructure, not a library. If you need a chatbot SDK, LangChain is great. If you need an AI operating system, keep reading.

quickStart.label: Get Started
quickStart.heading: Deploy in minutes
quickStart.description: No Python, no Docker, no runtime dependencies. Install the binary, set your API key, and start talking to your AI. That's the whole process.
quickStart.code: # Install cargo install --path crates/octos-cli # Initialize configuration octos init # Set your API key export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your-key # Start chatting in the terminal octos chat # Or launch the full gateway octos gateway # Or start the REST API server octos serve

items.question: How is Octos different from LangChain or CrewAI?
items.answer: Octos is an operating system, not a framework. It runs as a single binary — no Python, no Docker, no glue code. Built-in multi-tenancy, 12 messaging channels, and automatic provider failover. You configure agents through a REST API or a JSON file.

items.question: What LLMs does Octos support?
items.answer: 15 providers out of the box: Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, and more. You can chain multiple providers in a single pipeline — cheap models for planning, powerful ones for synthesis — with automatic failover if one goes down.

items.question: Can I run Octos on a small server?
items.answer: Yes. The binary is 31MB, cold starts in under 100ms, and needs zero external dependencies. A single Mac Mini can run 200+ agents. No Python runtime, no Docker, no Kubernetes.

items.question: Is Octos open source?
items.answer: Yes. Octos is fully open source under the MIT license and available on GitHub.

items.question: How do I connect a messaging channel?
items.answer: Just add the channel config to your profile. Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, WeChat, Email, and 6 more are built in — no plugins needed. Your agent shows up on all of them simultaneously.

items.question: Can multiple users share one Octos instance?
items.answer: Absolutely. Each user gets their own isolated agent with separate memory, sessions, and data. A family plan mode even supports sub-accounts — parent manages the billing, each person gets their own AI.
